name: Gin Rummy
tagline: Build sets and runs, cut your deadwood, and knock before your opponent does.
rulesSummary: Ten cards each. Make melds: sets (3 or 4 of a rank) or runs (3+ in a row in one suit; ace low, so A-2-3 but not Q-K-A). Other cards are deadwood: faces 10, ace 1, others their number.
First the non-dealer may take the upcard, then the dealer. After that, each turn draw from the stock or take the top discard, then discard (not the card you just took).
Knock when your deadwood after discarding is 10 or less. Your opponent then lays off deadwood on your melds (not after gin). Your melds are arranged for you.
Lower deadwood scores the difference. If your opponent ties or beats you, that's an undercut: they score the difference +10. Gin (no deadwood) scores their deadwood +20 and can't be undercut.
If a discard leaves only two cards in the stock, the hand is void. The winner of each hand deals the next.
At the target, the player who reached it gets 100 (200 if the other never scored), and each player adds 20 per hand won. Highest total wins.
Lobby options: 25-point bonuses make gin, undercut and each hand won 25. Big gin lets you go out with all 11 cards melded after drawing, for +31.
